items: 【Vibrant IPS HD Display with Widevine L1】Enjoy a crisp and bright viewing experience on the 8.7-inch IPS screen. Ideal for reading e-books, streaming YouTube, or browsing social media. Certified with Widevine L1, watch Netflix, Prime Video, and more in HD quality.

【Powerful Quad-Core Processor & Android 15】Equipped with a Quad-Core CPU up to 2.0GHz, this android 15 tablet delivers smooth performance for studying, gaming, and daily multitasking. Run on the latest Android 15 with smart gesture controls, app organization, and parental screen time management for a safer and smarter user experience.

【All-Day 5000mAh Battery for On-the-Go Use】Built with a 5000mAh lithium polymer battery, this android tablet supports hours of continuous use—perfect for long trips, study sessions, or entertainment without needing frequent recharging.

【Advanced Dual-band Wifi & Seamless Connectivity】 Stay connected with Dual-band Wifi and Bluetooth 5.0 for faster internet and stable accessory pairing. With dual speakers, Type-C port, 3.5mm headphone jack, and dual cameras (8MP rear + 2MP front), the tablet computer perfect for online classes, remote work, or travel. Use GPS for navigation and download all your favorite apps via Google Play Store.

【Expandable 11GB RAM & 1TB Storage】 Featuring 3GB + 8GB expandable RAM and 64GB internal storage (supports up to 1TB microSD card), you’ll have plenty of space for apps, photos, videos, and documents. Never worry about storage limits again.
